First touch (R1200, 17:5xZ): **p2 · domain:ui** → `pm:queue`.

Theme: zh-CN customers. This asks for a dynamic default on a dashboard text filter (the current ISO week), for an app's weekly dashboards. It is a feature with a named consumer, not a break: the app has worded around it. So p2.

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbUb7TcZK1XUAddUmQ

Seat ruling record · 2026-11-19T05:04Z

Ruling-ref: maintainer 2026-11-19T05:03Z on seat 5's decision card for #34938, option chosen verbatim: 「B 加一个固定占位符」. Analysis: project file `objectstack-seat5/area-ux/data-2/decision-35045-35046-34938.md`.

Execution (area data-2): add ONE fixed token for the current ISO week (suggested `{current_iso_week}`, resolving to `YYYY-Www`), in the same view-time token mechanism as the existing date macros, usable as a text filter default and in any filter condition. Loosening of a closed vocabulary, so `Clause-②: yes`. Only this one word: no expression defaults, no new week filter control. A static default (`2026-W47`) keeps working.

Serial constraints cleared: no other ux-1 card touches these files; the dev runs overlap-check before the first push.
Scope: ONE token `{current_iso_week}` resolving to `YYYY-Www` (ISO week, Monday start, workspace time zone, ISO week-year at year edges) on server and client, one rule; kept out of `DATE_MACRO_TOKENS` so date defaults and `calendar.initialDate` still refuse it; usable as a text filter default (box shows the resolved key) and in any filter condition; a static `2026-W47` default keeps working. No expression defaults, no week filter control, no last/next-week tokens. Client/server parity pin incl. year-edge days. `Fixes #34938`.
